defect: sceWlanDevIsPowerOn and sceWlanGetSwitchState were changed to return 1 unconditionally, so every game sees WLAN as powered on and switched on, which breaks Peace Walker and other games.
reason: The fix replaces exactly these two changed return values with a config check defaulting to off, and its message names the games broken by WLAN being reported on.

defect: The new GetBlockNumberFromEmuHackOp searches blocks by normalEntry without skipping destroyed (invalid) blocks, so an emuhack op can resolve to a dead block.
reason: The fix, titled as a bug caused by this JIT optimization, adds the invalid check and clears normalEntry on destroy in the lookup this change introduced.

defect: The newly computed neededBytes written to the reset buffer info is not limited to writableBytes, so the game can be told it must write more bytes than the buffer accepts.
reason: The fix clamps exactly this added value to first.writableBytes; before the change a different field was reported.

defect: The two added antialiasing rects double the wave's vertices to 24 per dp column without any cap, so a background wider than about 2730 dp overflows DrawBuffer's 65536-vertex buffer and hits its always-on assert.
reason: The fix adds a step that keeps the vertex count under MAX_VERTS, sized for the 24 vertices this change introduced; the dps gap issue it also fixes predates the change (wave animation commit).

defect: Replacing the explicit delete of audio before NativeShutdown with QScopedPointers makes the audio object and the thread destruct after NativeShutdown and net::Shutdown, which crashes on exit.
reason: The fix moves the scoped pointers into a helper so they are destroyed before NativeShutdown, exactly repairing the destruction order this change introduced.

defect: The fix changes the depal FBO texture binding from layer 0 to ALL_LAYERS after later commits made Vulkan framebuffers always array textures.
reason: At this change layer 0 on a single-layer framebuffer returned the same full image view as ALL_LAYERS, and single-pass stereo was not yet usable; the mismatch appeared with the later array-texture refactor (91259aa).

defect: The new sceJpegGetOutputInfo returns 0xC000 on a bad address or undecodable JPEG, which games such as God Eater Burst do not recognise as an error.
reason: The fix replaces exactly these added 0xC000 returns with a zero buffer size, which the game handles.

defect: The new readback copy loop computes the source row as mappedData + width * y, omitting the 4-byte pixel size, so the rows it copies are wrong.
reason: The loop only started copying (memcpy) in this change, and the fix multiplies the source offset by pixelSize.

defect: The new duplicate check compiles the vertex shader first and then, on a duplicate id, only logs and drops the compiled shader, leaking it.
reason: The fix moves compilation inside the not-duplicate branch, which removes the leak the added else-branch created.

defect: Enabling the fabsf entry with a null C replaceFunc makes the interpreter's Int_Emuhack call a null function pointer whenever fabsf is replaced.
reason: The fix adds a C Replace_fabsf to this entry and a null check in the interpreter; all other entries had a C function.

defect: Int_Emuhack checks the emuhack subop against 1 (EMUOP_RETKERNEL) instead of EMUOP_CALL_REPLACEMENT (2), so debug builds assert on every interpreted replacement call.
reason: The fix changes this comparison to EMUOP_CALL_REPLACEMENT; the null-replaceFunc check it also adds only became needed with later JIT-only entries.

defect: The commit halves 16-bit (and float) bone weights during decode (/65535) to match a new x2 in the vertex shader, but the software-transform path reads them through ReadWeights uncompensated, so its skinning uses half weights.
reason: The fix's message names a bug from this change, and it decodes 16-bit weights raw and adds U16 cases to ReadWeights to undo it; its removal of the w1 U8 cases was not a repair (restored later).

defect: SimulateGamepad tests pad_buttons with bitwise OR (|) instead of AND (&), so every condition is always true and the stick is always pushed.
reason: The fix replaces each | with & in the function this change added.

defect: The new underrun padding passes remains (a count of s16 samples) to memset as a byte count, clearing only half of the tail.
reason: The fix multiplies the memset length by sizeof(s16) on the line this change added.

defect: The camera-notch option is shown only on Android API 29 and higher, although the Java side reports safe insets from API 28 (P), so Android 9 devices never see it.
reason: The fix lowers exactly this added version check from 29 to 28, matching SizeManager.java.

defect: The new option update casts to the nonexistent type IOTimingMethod* (the enum is IOTimingMethods), so the libretro core does not compile.
reason: The fix corrects this cast to IOTimingMethods*, a compile failure in a line this change added.

defect: On shutdown the worker still locks doneMutex to notify completion, while the destroying thread holds doneMutex and waits in join, so destruction can deadlock.
reason: The fix notifies done only when active, removing the shutdown deadlock in the WorkerThread code this change added.

defect: Jit_PosS16Through converts the signed X and Y positions with an unsigned conversion (FConv::WU), although the code's own comment says they are signed.
reason: The fix changes those two conversions to signed FConv::W in the function this change added.

defect: The new NEON path assigns vreinterpret_s8_u64 (int8x8_t) to a uint8x8_t, a type mismatch that fails to compile on strict compilers.
reason: The fix replaces it with vreinterpret_u8_u64 on the line this change added (issue 19258).

defect: Splitting the single vfb loop into separate src and dst loops left the 0x44000/0x88000 video-size skip only in the dst loop, so such buffers became source candidates and copies were misdetected (Brothers in Arms).
reason: In the old loop that check's continue also skipped the source test for the buffer; the fix re-adds it to the src loop (issue 18512).

defect: On non-Windows, getLocalIp now overwrites the correct localip (from getsockname) with gethostbyname(gethostname()), which on POSIX systems typically gives a loopback address.
reason: The fix removes this added gethostbyname block for non-Windows and derives the address from the connected socket or the interfaces.

defect: The fix gives sceKernelReferThreadProfiler its real signature (no argument) and makes it return a zeroed profiler struct allocated in kernel memory.
reason: The change's stub ignored its argument and returned 0 like the unimplemented entry before it, so the fix adds a real implementation rather than repairing a regression.

defect: ChangeStatusShutdown now always starts the access-thread shutdown, even for a dialog that never started (status NONE), and UtilityDialogShutdown asserts that no other access thread is still running, which crashes when a hacked dialog start overlaps another dialog's shutdown.
reason: The fix skips the dialog shutdown thread when the start was skipped, guarding the call this change added; before the change shutdown used no thread or assert.

defect: SaveTextureTask creates the directory of filename (the replacement path under basePath_) instead of saveFilename (under newTextureDir_), so the save directory is not created.
reason: The fix changes filename.NavigateUp() to saveFilename.NavigateUp() on the line this change added.

defect: createAtrac takes IDs from a u8 counter that wraps without checking atracMap, so after 256 creations a new atrac can overwrite (and leak) one still in use.
reason: The fix loops until it finds an unused ID (masked to 0x3f) on the allocation line this change introduced; the old size-based scheme failed in a different scenario.

defect: The NEON LoadConvertS8 passes the int8x8_t value to vmovl_s16 instead of the widened value16, which is wrong and does not compile.
reason: The fix changes the argument to value16 in the function this change added (issue 19767).

defect: The fix replaces fmod with subtracting floor so that negative texture coordinates wrap into [0,1).
reason: Before the change negative coordinates were already converted to huge unsigned texel indices; the added wrapping fixed values above 1 but left negatives no worse than before.

defect: Thin3DFormatToFormatAndType asserts (PanicYesNo then Crash) on an unsupported format instead of only returning false, so a readback in a missing format crashes.
reason: The thin3d_gl.cpp code this replaced only logged; the fix removes the added assert and handles the false return.

defect: The new GraphicsScreen shows a Frame Skipping checkbox bound to a local bool fs but never writes it back to g_Config.iFrameSkip, so the setting cannot be changed there.
reason: Besides spacing, the fix adds g_Config.iFrameSkip = fs ? 1 : 0 after this added checkbox.

defect: The new clo implementation uses RSB(R0, rs, 0), the arithmetic negation, instead of a bitwise NOT before CLZ, so it counts leading ones wrongly.
reason: The fix replaces the RSB with an EOR against 0xFFFFFFFF in the case this change implemented.

defect: The new Android text drawer measures and renders strings without collapsing the UI's escaped '&&' to '&' (the Qt drawer does), so ampersands are displayed doubled.
reason: TextDrawerAndroid is created on Android from this commit on, and the fix adds NormalizeString to the measure and draw functions this change added.

defect: The new guard compiles the GL sky-plane preprocessing only under XR_USE_GRAPHICS_API_OPENGL, so on OpenGL ES VR builds (Quest) PreprocessStepVR becomes an empty stub and the sky-plane fix stops working.
reason: The fix extends both added #if guards to XR_USE_GRAPHICS_API_OPENGL_ES and calls it a break from this refactor.

defect: The new run loop swaps buffers first and then sets coreState back to CORE_RUNNING, overwriting a pause or quit request that arrived during the swap; on non-Windows it also resets NEXTFRAME, so the loop never returns.
reason: The fix sets CORE_RUNNING before the swap and only on Windows, fixing the crash on quit and the broken pause caused by the loop this change added.

defect: The file-dialog code stores c_str() of temporary wstrings from ConvertUTF8ToWString in OPENFILENAME (dangling pointers, and the NUL-separated filter is cut at its first NUL), and casts a std::string buffer to wchar_t*.
reason: The fix passes wide strings directly and copies the converted file name with wcscpy, replacing these added lines.

defect: On Symbian AllocateMemoryPages now calls mmap with fd -1 but without MAP_ANON, which fails (MAP_FAILED, not NULL), so the allocation is broken.
reason: The fix replaces this Symbian mmap path with new[] and frees it with delete[].

defect: When the emulator is not on top, the backbuffer is bound only in the else branch, assuming CopyDisplayToOutput always binds it; when nothing is presented no render target is bound and the following UI draw crashes.
reason: The fix binds the backbuffer whenever the GPU did not present this frame, repairing the crash on toggling Skip buffer effects while paused that this change exposed.

defect: The new GetSymbolInfo fast path returns the unique entry at start_address without checking that it actually covers address, so a duplicate start with a smaller size gives a range that excludes address and callers can loop forever.
reason: The fix adds the end-address check to this added fast path, fixing the infinite loop.

defect: The AutoRun default was changed from true to false, so with default settings games start in break mode (startBreak = !bAutoRun) instead of running.
reason: The stage-2 fix reverts this one changed default to true.

defect: reserve(entry->children.size() - 2) underflows size_t when a directory has fewer than two children, requesting a huge allocation that crashes.
reason: The fix removes this added reserve call, citing the crash in issue 15932.

defect: In the new applyRoundingMode, the skip for the default mode also jumps over the update of js.currentRoundingFunc, so after returning to the default mode the stale conversion function stays selected.
reason: The fix moves the skip target above the currentRoundingFunc update and initialises it, so ARM64 passes the fpu test again.
